effects: Through a delegate call, the Safe's singleton (storage slot 0) is overwritten with the immutable SAFE_SINGLETON 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a (Safe 1.4.1, non-L2), so all of the Safe's logic changes to that implementation.
Called directly instead of by delegate call, it reverts (onlyDelegateCall). No assets or native value move.

findings.title: migrateSingleton intent "Migrate Safe" does not name the target version (Safe 1.4.1, non-L2 singleton).
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateSingleton: `singleton = SAFE_SINGLETON;` with constructor arg safeSingleton = 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a (meta.json). Descriptor: "intent": "Migrate Safe". The target is immutable and the same on every CREATE2 deployment, so a constant intent can state it.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Upgrade Safe to v1.4.1" and add an interpolatedIntent with the same text.

findings.title: migrateSingleton: no field can show the new singleton address, because it is an immutable and not in the calldata.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol: `address public immutable SAFE_SINGLETON;` and the function takes no arguments. The descriptor has only the field `@.to` 'Migration contract'.

effects: Through a delegate call, the Safe's singleton is overwritten with SAFE_SINGLETON 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a (Safe 1.4.1, non-L2).

The Safe's fallback handler is then set to SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, which replaces the current handler. The handler answers unknown calls such as EIP-1271 isValidSignature and token callbacks.
The Safe emits ChangedMasterCopy and ChangedFallbackHandler. No assets or native value move.
formats.shown: Intent "Migrate Safe", the same as migrateSingleton, and the migration contract's name; nothing says the fallback handler changes.

findings.title: migrateWithFallbackHandler also replaces the Safe's fallback handler, but shows the same "Migrate Safe" intent as migrateSingleton.
findings.evidence: SafeMigration.sol migrateWithFallbackHandler: `migrateSingleton(); ISafe(address(this)).setFallbackHandler(SAFE_FALLBACK_HANDLER);`. Descriptor: "migrateWithFallbackHandler()": {"intent": "Migrate Safe", fields: [@.to 'Migration contract']}. The new handler decides which signatures the Safe accepts (isValidSignature) and replaces any custom handler the signer set. Nothing shown says so.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Upgrade Safe to v1.4.1 and set fallback handler" (or a shorter form under 50 characters, such as "Upgrade to v1.4.1 + new fallback handler") and add the same interpolatedIntent.
